purpose: Teach: 勝敗/最下位/制し/打者/飛ばさ/下級/背負う/威厳

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地元チームの勝敗、社員のモチベーションに影響する。
lines.en: The local team's performance affects our staff's morale.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Opening statement is clear, authoritative without sharpness. Slight pause between clauses. Speaking to someone who will understand the broader implication.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。最下位でも、応援、続けます。
lines.en: Yes. Even if they're last place, we'll keep supporting them.
lines.style: Steady, respectful agreement. Small breath between the confirmation and the follow-through. Resolute — not performing commitment, simply stating fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 逆境を制した選手、社内講演、招待しろ。
lines.en: Get athletes who've overcome adversity to speak here — internally.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Each phrase lands with quiet intent. Pauses for comprehension. Speaking as someone used to being followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。打者の代表選手、コラボ企画、進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll move forward with collaboration plans featuring a top batter.
lines.style: Professional confirmation with forward momentum. Firm on the action items. Respectful pacing — not rushed, not tentative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 宣伝、変な噂を飛ばさないよう、慎重に。
lines.en: Be cautious with the publicity — don't let strange rumors get started.
lines.style: Warning delivered evenly, not as alarm. Measured tempo. Implies experience with this kind of thing going wrong. Slightly protective.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 下級リーグ支援、CSRに組み込みます。
lines.en: We'll integrate lower-league support directly into our CSR initiatives.
lines.style: Specific and deliberate. Speaking with the authority of someone who's thought this through. Each concept placed carefully, building the structure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手の責任、背負う場面、丁寧に教えろ。
lines.en: Teach the younger staff how to carry that responsibility — walk them through it carefully.
lines.style: Directive with an undertone of care. The instruction matters; the execution matters more. Slight emphasis on 'carefully' — this is where mistakes cost.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営の威厳、地に着けて、保ちます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep management's integrity grounded and maintained.
lines.style: Closing affirmation with quiet weight. No flourish — just a steady commitment. Tone suggests understanding the stakes beneath the words.
